copy.headline: Trackdown: Baseball bat bandits steal thousands from multiple Academy stores in Tarrant County
copy.caption: Trackdown: Baseball bat bandits steal thousands from multiple Academy stores in Tarrant County. Stealing bases during a baseball game is legal, but stealing baseball bats from local Academy stores certainly isn't. Fort Worth Police are asking the public to help them catch two bat bandits.
